2. Rule violations: rows 1, 34, 51 had negative Quantity (-8, -6, -2) against the rules ("Quantity: min 1, always positive"), giving negative revenue — excluded (approved).
3. Formula violation: row 64 had Revenue 7,505 instead of Quantity × Price = 75 — recomputed per the rules formula.

Caveats: Date column was clean (all valid ISO dates). Category has 2 misspellings ("Office Suplies", "Furnture") and Region has whitespace/case variants plus 2 missing values, but these columns are not used in this question, so they were left untouched.
